key_insight: HVAF-sprayed WC-10Co-4Cr combined the lowest measured wear rate with the best corrosion resistance, while HVOF produced the highest hardness.
engineering_relevance: For WC-10Co-4Cr coatings on 304 stainless steel, spray-process selection strongly affects protection against wear and corrosion.
method: Deposited WC-10Co-4Cr using APS, detonation spraying, HVOF and HVAF.
Compared microstructure, Vickers hardness, friction and volume wear rates.
Evaluated corrosion performance and examined wear mechanisms.
evidence_signal: HVAF achieved a wear rate of (1.10±0.01)×10⁻⁵ mm³/(N·m), versus (36.82±0.80)×10⁻⁵ for uncoated steel, and the lowest coating corrosion current density at (1.75±0.02) μA/cm².
watch_item: The abstract does not specify wear-test conditions or corrosion medium, limiting extrapolation to service environments.
paper_title: Microstructure, Wear and Corrosion Resistances of Atmospheric Plasma, Detonation, High Velocity Oxy-fuel and High Velocity Air-fuel Sprayed WC-10Co-4Cr Cemented Carbide Coatings
